description: Owner-only: inspect whether a successful job artifact still has its default retention root. Released does not mean deleted or unavailable; actual bytes are checked at download. Does not expose native paths.

description: Owner-only bounded scan of persisted project revisions, task inputs and other task results, project media and plugin configuration for references to one published artifact. description: Owner-only: persist an idempotent review plan for one published artifact. Records exact native file and attempt-directory identity privately, default retention and bounded persisted reference roots. Planning never deletes bytes. An executable plan requires default retention released and zero protection roots; execution still rechecks all authorities under a publication fence and attempt lock.
name: opencut_artifact_gc_plan

description: Owner-only: inspect an immutable artifact review plan by plan_id after a lost response. A plan does not itself prove deletion eligibility; execution rechecks the live protection graph and native identity.
name: opencut_artifact_gc_inspect

description: Owner-only bounded discovery of durable artifact review plans. Cursor follows stored plan order and is bound to this workspace; plans are immutable observations. Query never deletes bytes or grants execution eligibility.
name: opencut_artifact_gc_query

description: Owner-only explicit execution of an unprotected, exact-hash artifact review plan. Holds the published attempt's exclusive native lock, rechecks retention and every persisted reference under the SQLite publication fence, then durably records removal or a conservative changed/absent outcome. description: Owner-only read of a plan's durable removal state. Removing is unresolved and requires explicit execute retry with the same plan hash; planned, busy and retained are not deletion receipts.

description: Owner-only: durably release one successful job artifact's default retention root under an exact idempotency key. Does not delete bytes, alter job success or override other retained references. Inspect before retrying with a different key.

description: Owner-only bounded native storage observation. Reports managed categories, unique inode bytes, partial scans and volume availability without exposing paths. Live scan, not an atomic snapshot, quota reservation or garbage-collection plan. Never deletes or repairs files.

bookmark_id.description: Stable client-supplied identity, used only when inserting.

BoxMaskGeometry.description:
Center offsets and dimensions are fractions of the untransformed element,
not normalized canvas coordinates. Classic scale is retained even where a
particular shape renderer does not use it, so recovery never loses fields.

track_id.description:
The sole owning caption track in this sequence, providing visibility,
locking and layer order. Promoting legacy sequence-wide captions creates
an explicit caption track at their original overlay position.

alpha.description: Straight alpha, independent of RGB encoding.

dt.description: Signed exact time offset, not a normalized ease fraction.

dv.description: Signed value offset in the bound parameter's units.

oneOf.description: sigmaX=intensity/5*width/1920, sigmaY=intensity/5*height/1080.

this is not a new claim of physically correct EV color processing.

below, including background. It is not copied onto each lower element.

not sample this span, but split/resize/recovery still need it. For media,

multiplied by rate and rounded once to the Classic tick grid. Animated
properties always use timeline-local time, without adding trim_start.
source_duration is the original extent/resize ceiling, not a second
visible range; None preserves Classic's inferred, extendable extent.
Exact old Rust media span; the referenced asset supplies the full extent.

Preserves unresolved family semantics on import. A renderer must report
resolution/identity; saving this is not proof of reproducible output.

Actual pixels = value * layout height / 90. Title layout height is the
project canvas height; text-mask layout height is its element height.

FreeformPoint.description:
Coordinates and absolute handle positions are normalized element-local
coordinates around its center, matching Classic's stored path geometry.

oneOf.description:
Preserves zero and arbitrarily quiet legacy nonzero gains. Channels
interpolate linear amplitude, as the old project contract specified.
Classic default 0 dB, UI -60..20; amplitude is 10^(value/20).
Fractional animated counts are preserved; Classic rounds at evaluation.
Classic mask star is fixed at five points with inner radius 0.45.
V3 masks use top-left canvas coordinates and canvas-normalized sizes.

normalizations.description: Reviewable adaptation facts,not renderer or pixel-identity evidence.

oneOf.description:
Set source artwork, or null to restore automatic artwork. Assets must
belong to the proposed project; asset_bind may precede this atomically.

sequences.description:
Typed complete scenes, including bookmarks, source spans and channels.
Their presence does not imply compiler or renderer support.

oneOf.description: The private legacy locator is deliberately not part of this schema.

Visible source duration = round(timeline_duration*rate*timebase)/timebase,
positive ties upward. A rate-edit derives a new timeline duration from
the preserved source extent using the inverse operation, once. These
operations are quantized and must not be assumed to be exact inverses.
RGB values/tangents are linear-sRGB; alpha is not gamma encoded.

segment_id.description:
Optional independent segment identity, preserving a V3 curve node ID.
Classic segments are owned by the outgoing key and need no second ID.

time.description: Element-local time; track channels use sequence time.

ScalarParameter.description:
Each variant identifies both meaning and stored unit. Applicability and
post-evaluation bounds belong to the versioned parameter registry.

oneOf.description:
Actual time/value control points; equal endpoints may still have a bump.
A missing outgoing/incoming handle uses +/- segment duration / 3 and
+/- value delta / 3, respectively. Both absent gives linear interpolation;
tangent-mode hints never silently replace these stored/default controls.
Exact old ease interpolation, kept separate from time/value tangents.

tracks.description: Visual/effect track order is bottom to top, independent of insertion ID.

channels.description: Track-owned channels use sequence time, never an arbitrary element clock.

elements.description:
Stable element order is also the layer order for overlapping legacy
Graphic tracks. Classic tracks retain non-overlapping edit semantics.

SettingsProfile.description:
New and Classic-imported projects use ClassicGlobal. LegacyPerScene is an
explicit preservation profile for heterogeneous old Rust projects, never a
hidden override of Classic settings. Converting its scope is a separate edit.

corner_radius_percent.description: Classic 0..100 radius percentage, not a pixel radius.

padding_x_at_size15.description:
Classic padding pixels at font-size 15; actual padding multiplies by
font size / 15. Offsets remain pixels and do not use that multiplier.

source_span.description:
The only source/local span authority. Media content refers to this span;
it does not carry a second independently writable source range.

visual.description: Audio-only elements have no visual style.

position_x_px.description: Canvas pixels from center, positive right/down, for both media layouts.

effects.description: Ordered, identity-bearing stacks; disabled nodes remain editable.

description: Owner-only list verified WASM and declarative preset packages with exact dependency identities. No installation paths or project authorization inferred.
name: opencut_plugin_list

description: Owner-only inspect one installed package by capability kind and exact dependency identity;no installation paths.
name: opencut_plugin_inspect

description: Owner-only install one supported package kind from an explicit local source. Optional expected_package_sha256 pins reviewed restore actions. Original manifest checks,permission limits,immutable version locks and fenced publication apply;installation grants no project authority.

expected_package_sha256.description: Present for a reviewed package restore. An incorrect pin cannot publish.

name: opencut_plugin_install

description: Owner-only bounded authorization denial audit, including anonymous authentication failures. Filter by server request, verified principal or credential. At most 10000 records retained, 200 per page; stale cursors expire. Never includes tokens, request bodies or original URLs.
name: opencut_denial_query

description: Owner-only compare-and-set project plugin policy, pinned to package SHA and named contributions. Revision 0 creates. Idempotent receipt; does not change project head or install packages.
name: opencut_project_plugin_grant

description: Read this project's plugin policies (maximum 64, including disabled). Grants are not installation availability; inspect a named contribution for its current contract.
name: opencut_project_plugin_list

description: Discover a granted project's contribution with inline JSON schemas and effective host limits, without native paths. Requires project read, enabled exact-package policy and global plugin permissions.
name: opencut_project_plugin_inspect

description: Propose 1..32 ordinary public edits and a complete preview against a fixed existing branch head. Requires read,edit,run_jobs and an enabled exact-package project grant for every caller. Actual dependency ABI selects only private function bindings;no development protocol selector or legacy operation fallback. Rechecks grant/package/current authority and edit planning. Does not commit;apply the returned transaction explicitly with edit.apply.
